premises: Pre-oxidation at ~1050°C for 10 hours in air forms a continuous, protective Al-rich oxide scale on high-entropy alloy bond coats.
The pre-formed Al2O3 layer acts as a diffusion barrier that slows further oxidation and mitigates oxide scale spallation.
